prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need. To give you a useful recommendation I need a few details, or I can explain how to find and evaluate the best match. Quick questions that will let me recommend a short list:

- What type of marketing do you need? (digital/SEO/PPC/social media/content/branding/video/PR/B2B/B2C)
- What’s your industry or target audience?
- Rough monthly budget or project size?
- Do you want a local Maryland agency or are remote/national firms OK?
- Timeline or major deliverables (ongoing retainer vs one project)?

If you want to search yourself, good places to find top-rated Maryland agencies:
- Clutch.co and The Manifest (client reviews, case studies)
- UpCity and DesignRush
- Google Maps and LinkedIn (local presence + employee backgrounds)
- Industry awards/press (Ad Age, local business journals)

How to choose (criteria and interview questions):
- Relevant experience and case studies for your industry/goal
- Measurable results (KPIs, ROI examples)
- Team composition and who will work on your account
- Reporting cadence and tools they use
- Pricing model and contract terms
- References from current/past clients

Red flags:
- Vague promises like “we’ll get you to #1” without a plan
- No measurable results or KPIs
- Poor communication during sales process
- Overly aggressive long-term contracts with no exit terms

If you tell me the answers to the questions above I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies (or nearby firms) that fit your needs and explain why each is a good match. Which services and budget are you working with?
